lyricsEditor.help1: “1.” at the start of a line starts stanza 1 (a blank line between stanzas is recommended).
lyricsEditor.help2: “R.” or “Refrain:” starts the refrain. A “Ba longo…” at the end of a stanza points to the refrain, as in the book.
lyricsEditor.help3: Duala letters: e̱ o̱ (underlined), ɛ ɔ ŋ ń ḿ, apostrophe ’ (Mun’a).

import.title: Book import
import.intro: Paste the text of digitised pages (copy or OCR). Each hymn starts with its number alone on a line, then the reference line and the stanzas “1.”, “2.”… A lone number followed by anything else is read as a page number.
import.placeholder:
5
M.B.8. - Evang. S. 189.
1. Edube na Loba!
…
import.rules: Nothing is saved until you click Save.
